title: Enough
coreMove: Stillness grows when you mark the enough line before comparison speaks, then let ambition serve a chosen life instead of chasing the next visible upgrade.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a pay memo could become either fair stewardship or a chase after a rival's number
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Discovery comes from records, not action: the telling detail is the moving target.

exampleSpecs.audience: solo workers comparing tools and status signals
exampleSpecs.stakes: scarce attention could go to better work or to another status purchase
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Stay inside Ahmed's head as he reasons through the desire without outside dialogue.

exampleSpecs.stakes: limited rehearsal hours could serve the play or feed prestige anxiety
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Keep the whole scene in pre-action planning over scarce time.

exampleSpecs.audience: founders weighing growth against life costs
exampleSpecs.stakes: a bigger raise could buy status while consuming the life the company was meant to protect
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Make the two-bad-options tension explicit and keep this as the chapter's only binary decision.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a campaign target could serve the mission or become an endless prestige chase
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Let the lesson emerge through two named people talking.

exampleSpecs.audience: teams measuring user happiness by volume
exampleSpecs.stakes: a launch metric could reward more use while missing better use
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Set up the expected win, then reveal that more engagement did not mean a better life.
